name: Ferrofluid Chamber
promptTemplate: A pool of ferrofluid driven into {{spike_density}} sharp spikes by a {{magnet_mode}} field at {{magnet_strength}} power with {{sheen}} luster, animated with {{viscosity}} dynamics and {{studio_rim}} studio rim glow.

magnet_mode.hint: Cycle how the invisible magnetic poles travel

sheen.hint: Spectral iridescence reflecting off the spikes

spike_density.hint: Grid resolution of the ferrofluid peaks

magnet_strength.hint: Crank up to elevate towering sharp spikes

studio_rim.hint: Cast luminous edge highlights onto the pool

listing.blurb: A pool of glossy ferrofluid erupts into sharp iridescent spikes under magnetic forces while the room steers liquid viscosity, luster, and pole trajectories.
listing.prompt: Ferrofluid: a pool of glossy black liquid that rises into rows of sharp spikes as an unseen magnet approaches, the spikes swaying, merging and collapsing back into a mirror-smooth puddle, a studio light gleaming on every spike. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
